full_judgment: 12. The case of Helaluddin Ahmed alias Swapan vs. Bangladesh and others reported in 1993 BLD (AD) 17 has been also cited. The appeal arose out of the order passed by the Chief Martial Law Administrator in exercise of power of review under Regulation 3(4) of the Martial Law Regulation No.1 of 1982 and hence the said case is not relevant for deciding the point involved in the present case. Mr. MA Aziz, the learned Counsel for the petitioner took serious objection with regard to the jurisdiction of the Summary Martial Law Court in taking cognizance of the offence and holding trial and passing the order of conviction and sentence in the case which was not transferred to the said court by the lawful martial law authority. The learned Counsel for the petitioner has pointed out that the case was transferred by the Zonal Martial Law Administrator to the Special Martial Law Court without having such power and this has vitiated the trial rendering order of conviction and sentence coram non judice. Mr. AK Mujibur Rahman has produced before the Court Bangladesh Gazette Notification No. 143 dated 25th July, 1983 showing that Sudharam PS Case No.1, dated 5.1.83 under sections 364/302/201 BPC which was pending before the Sub-Divisional Magistrate was transferred to the Special Martial Law Court No.4 Comilla by an order of Major General Nazrul Aziz Chisti who was authorized in this behalf in exercise of power conferred by regulation 2(3) of the Martial Law Regulation, 1982 (Martial Law Regulation No.1 of 1982) and since the act of transfer was done on behalf of Chief Martial Law Administrator the order passed by the Special Martial Law Court was not coram non judice.
